samples: This program fetches all customer records from a paginated API by following cursor links across multiple pages, then groups the customers by country and prints a sorted count of how many customers are in each country. It demonstrates cursor-based pagination handling and data aggregation in Renyi, with a test that verifies the pagination logic works correctly against recorded API responses.

This program fetches all customer records from a paginated API by following cursor links across multiple pages, then groups the customers by country and prints a sorted count of how many customers are in each country. It demonstrates cursor-based pagination handling and data aggregation in Renyi. The included test verifies that the pagination logic correctly retrieves all records from a multi-page response.
